tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams.

cover_en.subject: Application: IT Project Manager SAP Commerce (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my interest in the IT Project Manager SAP Commerce position at REHAU. With over 5 years of professional experience as an SAP Commerce Cloud Developer at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical knowledge in delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing and customer data management.

bullets.label: API and Integration Delivery
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and designed PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub to keep product catalogs synchronized across global channels.

bullets.label: Process & DevOps Execution
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows while performing code reviews and supporting production issues.

bullets.label: Technical Leadership
bullets.text: Investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee platforms while providing technical guidance to junior developers.

cover_en.gap: While my professional background is centered on hands-on backend development and technical implementation in SAP Commerce rather than formal project management, I am very keen to learn and take on broader coordination responsibilities.
cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit, and am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15.12.2026 (earliest start date 16.12.2026). I would welcome the opportunity to discuss my application further in an interview.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als IT Project Manager SAP Commerce (m/w/d)
cover_de.hook: Mit großem Interesse bewerbe ich mich bei REHAU für die Position als IT Project Manager SAP Commerce. Als SAP Commerce Cloud Developer bringe ich mehr als fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung bei Rockwell Automation und Shell sowie fundierte technische Kenntnisse in der Umsetzung großer E-Commerce-Plattformen mit.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud
bullets.text: Entwicklung von Backend- und Frontend-Funktionalitäten auf Basis von SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) mit Java und Spring für Produkt-, Katalog-, Preis- und Kundendatenmanagement.

bullets.label: Schnittstellen & Integration
bullets.text: Bereitstellung von OCC REST Web Services sowie Konzeption und Optimierung von PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines mittels Profisee, Hotfoldern und DataHub.

bullets.label: DevOps & CI/CD
bullets.text: Ausführung von CI/CD-Deployment-Zyklen und Release-Builds auf dem SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) im Rahmen agiler Workflows.

bullets.label: Technische Betreuung
bullets.text: Klärung von Integrationsproblemen zwischen SAP ERP, MDM und Profisee sowie Durchführung von Code Reviews und technische Unterstützung von Junior-Entwicklern.

cover_de.gap: Da mein Schwerpunkt bisher primär auf der technischen Entwicklung und Implementierung im SAP-Commerce-Umfeld liegt, freue ich mich darauf, mich in weitergehende Projektmanagement-Aufgaben einzuarbeiten.
cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, verfüge über eine gültige deutsche Aufenthalts- und Arbeitserlaubnis und befinde mich in einer Kündigungsfrist mit letztem Arbeitstag am 15.12.2026 (frühester Eintrittstermin 16.12.2026). Ich freue mich auf ein persönliches Gespräch.

tailoring.why_company: REHAU is a globally recognized manufacturing leader with high standards in digital enterprise solutions. Contributing my SAP Commerce expertise here offers an exciting opportunity to support complex international e-commerce platforms.
tailoring.motivation_short: I am motivated to apply my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience to help REHAU build robust e-commerce architectures.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I saw the IT Project Manager SAP Commerce role at REHAU. With 5+ years in SAP Commerce Cloud at Rockwell and Shell, I bring strong Java and integration skills. My last working day is 15.12.2026. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: IT Project Manager SAP Commerce (m/w/d) - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application documents for the IT Project Manager SAP Commerce role at REHAU. With over 5 years of professional experience as an SAP Commerce Cloud Developer at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong expertise in Java, Spring, REST APIs, and enterprise e-commerce platforms.

I hold a valid German work permit and am serving notice until 15.12.2026 (earliest start 16.12.2026). I look forward to discussing how my technical background aligns with your team.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
